howTitle: A fresh coat in three steps.

steps.name: Free estimate
steps.text: We evaluate your property, talk through colors and timing, and give you a detailed quote.

steps.name: Prep and protect
steps.text: We sand, patch, prime and cover every surface before any paint goes on.

steps.name: Paint and walk through
steps.text: We apply each coat with care, then inspect every detail with you.
